comment: Dr. Mowery is very nice and helpful. 12 pop quizzes but all of them are based on readings. 3 exams: they are easy if you memorize the sociological terms and participate in class. Papers are mainly about self-reflection. No phone policy, and she doesn't put powerpoint slides on blackboard, so make sure to attend classes.
Very nice and listens to her students but became less attentive towards the end of the semester. Test questions can be hard to understand and no extra credit is possible.

Dr. Mowery created an engaging, sometimes really entertaining, class through discussions on the readings(sometimes long but mostly interesting) and slides(only available in class). Readings were checked with unannounced, in-class quizzes. Dr. Mowery was accessible outside of class and is easy to talk to, definitely cares about her students.

Dr. Mowery is an excellent teacher for students both interested in sociology and for those who just need their gen ed reqs filled. Even though she demands participation, there's no pressure on giving the right answer, and most of the time discussions become very entertaining. She's a great teacher, and her exams are easy. Def take SOC 101 if u can.

Took this class for lib arts credit and was interested, ended up being my favorite class of the semester. Lectures are so interesting and Dr. Mowery makes class so engaging and makes sure everyone understands. Readings for each class can be long but they're interesting. Goes out of her way to help students do well and if you study, tests are easy.

Her class is engaging and fun. Does not allow technology nor puts powerpoints online so always be in attendance or get notes from someone else. Not as easy as everyone else says but she is super helpful. As long as you study and do all the readings you will be okay on the tests. Papers are super easy. Engage and put in effort and you'll be good.

I liked Mowery a lot. She isn't as easy as everyone says because she gives basically a small quiz for every reading every day, but her grading on essays is pretty easy, and tests aren't terrible if you study. Make sure you talk in her class because it is a discussion based class, and she will help you with answers as long as you try

Professor Mowery is an amazing professor! She makes class engaging & fun keeping everyone always interested. She assigns papers throughout the semester all of which are extremely easy to write & get an A on. She does assign reading that is mandatory but readings are always interesting & she never assigns over 20 pages, making it very manageable.

Professor Mowery is extremely informative and her discussions are engaging. People in my class felt like she expected too much from an intro course but generally gave about an assignment a week. Her grading is a little tougher than basic expectations but nothing impossible. I got an A+ and didn't ever feel overwhelmed. Expect whiners in her class!
Great teacher; tough, but fair. I loved reading about famous case studies.

She is AMAZING. Very knowledgeable on the subject but assigns a lot of writing in comparison with other SOC 101 professors. There is also a lot of reading on a regular basis. The reading is really interesting and she makes each section connect easily to the next and uses a lot of real life examples. Also SUPER NICE and helpful with assignments.

I loved her.  After taking her class as an elective i decided to change my major to sociology.  Good portion of grades is writing assignments, answer ALL parts of the question to get a good grade.  Class participation is also key.
really likes general statements and refuses to accept ideas that conflict with "broad trends"

She's a pretty good professor. Interesting class, although she tends to accidently linger on one topic for too long and then have to speed through another. As long as you write down what she writes on the board and read Henslin, you have pretty much all the information you need for the exams.
